notes:
Short notes / call fragments:
- Primary use: subscription & billing support agents handling Stripe + Zuora flows. Must support tool-calling to fetch invoices, create refunds, and produce structured JSON actions consumed by backend.
- Latency SLO: target p50 streaming <150ms for turn-taking flows; p95 ideally <300ms for small JSON responses (under 1k tokens). Current POC p50 ~120ms, p95 spikes on long invoice contexts.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market; wants predictable unit economics. Considering hosted to start, commit to Dedicated when monthly token spend ~$25k.
- Security: requires SAML SSO, SOC2 Type II evidence, KMS integration for encryption-at-rest, audit logs for tool calls, and EU data residency for EU customers.
- Quote from Head of Ops: "We need the agent to do exact JSON outputs for ops automation — no ambiguous text. If the tool call returns a refund payload, it must be a strict schema."
- Implementation notes: using Stripe webhooks, Zuora REST endpoints; wants Redwood tool-calling to be able to produce both dry-run JSON and execute action via backend hook. Prefers function/tool signature that maps 1:1 to internal microservices.
- POC artifacts: demo recording (ff_2025-01-21_8312), sandbox API keys issued, security questionnaire in Drive link.
- Internal stakeholders: Head of Product (Maya Chen), Head of Ops (Luis Morales), Engineering Manager (Samir Patel), Procurement (Elena Torres).
- Risks: long invoice contexts (10-20k tokens) cause tail latency and memory pressure; team exploring quantized model variants and prefix/KV caching.
- Open asks for Redwood: provide Dedicated pricing tiers (committed v. burst), SLA on streaming tail latency, examples of tool-calling JSON schemas used by other customers, copy of SOC2 report and KMS integration guide.
- Next talk: deep-dive with SE on streaming kernel selection and fallbacks (scheduled w/ Marco on 2025-02-24)
use_case_summary: Moneta is building a billing/subscription support agent that routes to Stripe and Zuora. The agent must stream partial answers, call tools (read/create invoices, refunds), and output strict JSON actions for downstream automation. Initial pilot on Hosted API; planned migration to Dedicated when throughput and predictability needs rise.
notes_summary: Evaluating Hosted API for chat-based billing agents. POC shows promising latency but p95 spikes on long context. Strong security and residency requirements. Next step: finalize POC metrics and Dedicated pricing options.
